Work cross-functionally with operations, packaging, distribution, and QA teams to ensure the upgrade experience is reliable and smooth for all customers. Strong written communication skills and comfort working asynchronously in an all-remote, distributed team. Contribute to a dependency graph migration system that supports safe ordering, parallel execution, and three-phase, low-downtime upgrades. Mentor intermediate engineers through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Make and document technical decisions asynchronously so team members can build on them across time zones. Review schema migrations from engineers across GitLab for safety, backward compatibility, and reliability. A track record of leading delivery of a system from design through implementation and adoption. Experience mentoring engineers through pairing, code review, and technical feedback. Strong written communication and the ability to make progress independently in an asynchronous, distributed environment. Sound judgment when balancing reliability, safety, backward compatibility, and delivery needs. An interest in serving as a senior technical presence for an India-based engineering group while collaborating across regions. CRED was born out of a need to restore focus on a long-lost virtue — trust. the idea: create a community built on trust and scale this behaviour until it becomes the norm. building a community like this requires a community of its own; a group of passionate, driven people with the freedom to take big swings and chase meaningful outcomes. a group that believes in solving problems elegantly, moving fast, thinking first principles, and constantly raising the bar. here's what will be in store for you at CRED once you join the team. as a lead within the payments pod, you will own the end-to-end strategy, growth, and p&l for one of CRED's most important engagement surfaces — high-frequency, transactional payment categories that form the backbone of member habit and retention. this role is responsible for step-change growth — scaling active transacting members 2–3× by making on-deck payment flows habit-forming, low-friction, and trust-reinforcing for CRED members. The mandate is not short-term monetisation, but maximising active transacting members at the lowest cost to serve, while building a compliant, resilient, and scalable business. you will work closely with product, engineering, compliance, and external ecosystem partners to define the future roadmap for the category and translate strategy into execution.
